summary: Prepared a dark macOS-inspired native KDE Plasma desktop alongside GNOME
changes: Installed Plasma 6.8 and desktop integration tools from configured repositories, adding 159 packages. Retained GNOME and GDM. Prepared a user-only dark violet color scheme, static geometric wallpaper, top bar, floating autohide dock, left window controls and US International layout. Enabled native blur and disabled wobbly and magic-lamp effects. Standard package hooks created the i2c group without adding a user. No logout, reboot, GPU or power policy changes. Private backups and package manifests retained.
tests: Package file-presence checks passed; custom global theme recognized by KPackage; theme selection and keyboard readback verified; wallpaper XML valid; GDM active; no failed system units. Plasma session entry installed. First-login appearance and game performance remain untested. Memory/load snapshots are not a representative performance comparison.
rollback: Select GNOME at login. A private rollback script restores the previous user configuration and removes the theme files created by this task. Added packages remain installed pending a reviewed removal plan.
problem: User requested a different desktop appearance; no reproducible distribution defect established.
solution: Prepared native Plasma customization with a static background and limited desktop effects.
reproduction: No distribution defect reproduction; visual acceptance requires first login to Plasma.
